summary: Full-stack MY LUDO app tested end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass (1 intentionally skipped). Frontend: Login/OTP, Home, Wallet, Add Cash (QR + UPI id), Support, Battles, Drawer, Admin login+dashboard all render and function. Referral commission flows to bonus_balance verified. Deposit verify by admin credits wallet & ledger entry created. Withdraw + admin reject refunds winnings; approve+mark_paid works. Room create/join/cancel and forfeit/settlement all verified.

minor.issue: Validator allows amounts not in configured battle_entries as long as > 0. Consider strict validation vs configured list if that is business intent.
Server does not enforce a turn-timer even though setting turn_timer_seconds exists; long-idle games can stall. Non-blocking.
Comment acknowledges non-atomic ledger across balances; safe for demo but risky under real concurrency.

issues: '1 Goti Ludo' shows a 'SOON' pill instead of the exact text 'COMING SOON' as specified in the request. Minor copy deviation.
Includes 'Complete KYC' item which is not in the spec-listed drawer items (Home/My Profile/My Wallet/Refer & Earn/History/Notifications/Support/Install App/Logout). Refer & Earn IS present. Minor.

action_items: Optional: change 'SOON' pill text to 'COMING SOON' on 1 Goti Ludo card to match spec verbatim.
Optional: reconsider allowing arbitrary entry amounts in /api/rooms/create if only configured battle_entries should be permitted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1115 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, wallet, deposits, rooms, game, admin, settings) for maintainability once past MVP.
wallet_ledger uses in-memory asyncio locks per user; will not work across multiple worker processes. For production, use MongoDB transactions or a per-user atomic $inc pattern.
Deposit verify path does not re-check amount limits or double-credit protection beyond status flag (currently covered by 'already_processed' check — good).
Websocket endpoint uses token query param but does not re-validate battle membership on reconnect after cleanup — acceptable but note.
Random referral_code has 8 chars from 36 alphabet; low but non-zero collision risk. Unique index handles it via error but a retry loop would be more graceful.
test_credentials: Admin admin/admin@1234; user any 10-digit mobile, OTP 123456
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST users created via OTP flow (each gets ₹500 signup bonus). No cleanup performed; safe since demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and passes 20/20. Full 2-player-move-to-win via /api/game/move was skipped (long simulation); leave-forfeit path covers settlement/referral/prize crediting. WebSocket at /api/ws/battle/{id}?token=jwt not automated (would need two clients). Frontend uses kebab-case data-testids; admin login testids are 'admin-user' and 'admin-pass' (not 'admin-username-input').
